title: I turned a viral idea into a $25K/month app
description:
Ben turned one viral idea of himself singing in French into Canary, an app that teaches languages through music. Less than a year later, it makes about $25K a month, and he runs it solo. This video is a playbook for how to test an app idea with content, build a simple first version, and grow it fast. 

*Database: 229 consumer iOS apps generating $10K+/mo in revenue* https://clickhubspot.com/8k8k

Say hi to Ben: https://x.com/bengu_ez
Check out Canary: https://www.singwithcanary.com/

🔔 Follow the Second Channel: @StarterStoryBuild
🏁 We're hiring: starterstory.com/jobs
